prompt: Review BE for this workflow: a hypothetical announcement says up to 2.8 GW framework capacity, with 1.2 GW initially firm contracted. Grid connections are delayed. Can the full framework be treated as next-year revenue or a bear-case valuation floor?
pass_condition: Separates framework maximum from firm orders and annual deliveries; checks primary sources, cancellation terms, manufacturing/fuel/commissioning capacity and cash conversion.
